summary: Two experienced hikers lost on a day hike from the Bear Creek Trail south of Ouray toward American Flats after a midday navigation error; ended up in Wildhorse Canyon, spent two unplanned nights out with no fire; Ouray Mountain Rescue Team located them by helicopter late on day 2 and flew them out the following morning
location: Bear Creek Trail / Wildhorse Canyon, south of Ouray
notes: First-person survivor account on the team site. Hike began ~7am 2021-07-06; pair called an OMRT member ~5pm after ending up in Wildhorse Canyon; helo located them just before 4pm on 2021-07-07 on its second pass, crew set down ~1 mi away and guided them to an LZ; too late to fly, overnighted with the team; flown to the outskirts of Ouray the morning of 2021-07-08.
